notes.title: Small patch note.
notes.content:
[b]Hello ! welcome in this new blog-post before the release of ItemDay, i will show you
more about my recent improvement : In-game doors and Lobby ![/b]

[u][b]Doors : [/b][/u]

"The killer is chasing you? nah just close the door"

[url=https://i.ibb.co/dPSNp0G/image-2023-05-23-181504003.png][img]https://i.ibb.co/dPSNp0G/image-2023-05-23-181504003.png[/img][/url]

Today i worked on a door system for ItemDay to make chase a little bit complex for killers, and survivors !
The system is pretty simple and well known on other games, Some doors spawn on the map near strategical points, Survivors can close them ([i]or re-open them of course[/i]) 
Killers can't jump over the door, but can break it, also, killers are not stun if a survivor close the door on his face.

Everything you see there are still "Developement in progress" please remember that i'm the only developer of ItemDay, so yeah 🙂 hope you will enjoy the game !
i can't wait to share more with you later

[u][b]Lobby :[/b][/u]

Lobby's are an important part of a video-game, we improve it to make it more easy to acces, and understand.
You can there, Change your avatar, customise It, chat with your friends, 
and do many things inside ! here is a little snippets of what it's looking for now
([i]still work in progress[/i])

notes.title: First patch note.
notes.content:
Hello, just a quick message to say to everyone that I'm still working actively on the game. Today I finished the Hit / Downed / revival system, I also fixed many bugs 
and I decided to create a little patch note "like" To show every changes made in this build that you unfortunately have no access

[b]Gameplay improvement[/b]
[list]
[*] Survivors can now be downed on the ground waiting for a revival
[*] Survivors can now revive their teammates on the floor
[*] Killers can now Hit and kill the survivors
[*] Killers can now damage the corruption removal progression
[/list]

[b]Values changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Survivors health after being revives has been decreased : [b]100>80[/b]
[*] Killer Damage has been decreased : [b]35>25[/b]
[*] Survivor's speed has been increased : [b]300>400[/b]
[*] Corruption removal progression : [b]10 - 1 each seconds[/b]
[/list]

[b]Gameplay changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Survivors need to remove 5 corruption and wait 1 minute to exit
[/list]

Thanks for following IteamDay development
